plugins.name: lvai-pro
plugins.description: The complete Legal Velocity AI platform for Claude. Legal research, citation verification, Citation Binders and legal writing on the Midpage or Descrybe connector — whichever the firm has (both are cross-checked when both are connected); NJ and NY real estate transaction management (contracts, riders, closing documents, title review, date calendaring); intelligent PDF form filling. Skill content is delivered by the Legal Velocity connector under the firm's license.

skills.name: case-summary
skills.description: Produce detailed case summaries and analyses of specific court opinions. Use when the user asks to "summarize this case", "analyze this opinion", "what did the court hold in", "case summary for", "brief this case", "case analysis of", "explain this ruling", or needs a comprehensive breakdown of a specific court decision — read from the actual opinion on the Midpage or Descrybe connector, whichever the user has (both, when both are connected).
skills.description_zh: 通过用户已连接的Midpage或Descrybe读取法院实际意见，对具体判决形成详细案件摘要、裁判结论与分析；两者都连接时同时使用。

skills.name: citation-binder
skills.description: Build a verified Citation Binder (Word document) from a brief, motion, or memorandum. Verifies every citation against the real opinion on the Midpage or Descrybe connector (both, when both are connected), extracts the proposition the brief attributes to each case AND the proposition the case actually states, compares the two for accuracy, and assembles a tabbed binder with verified pull-quotes, citator treatment, and accuracy assessments. Use when the user asks to "build a citation binder", "create a citation binder", "build a case binder", "binder of the cases", "verify and bind citations", "table of authorities with pull-quotes", "citation binder for this brief", "compare my propositions to the cases", "check my brief's propositions against the actual opinions", or uploads a legal document and wants a courtroom-ready, verified authorities binder.
skills.description_zh: 从诉讼书状、动议或备忘录生成Word判例引文册，通过Midpage或Descrybe核验每项引文，对比书状归因主张与判例实际主张，汇集已核验摘引、后续引用处理及准确性评估。

skills.name: closing-documents
skills.description: Generate real estate closing documents for a transaction. Use when the user asks to "prepare closing documents", "draft a deed", "create affidavit of title", "prepare GIT form", "affidavit of consideration", "seller closing documents", "closing package", "settlement documents", "prepare deed", "generate closing docs", "seller documents", "transfer documents", "deed prep", "closing paperwork", or needs any combination of deeds, affidavits, tax forms, or transfer documents for a NJ or NY real estate closing. Produces Word documents from firm templates and auto-fills bundled government PDF forms via LVAI PDF Filler integration.
skills.description_zh: 依据律所模板生成新泽西或纽约房地产交割Word文件，包括契据、产权和对价宣誓书、税表及转让文书，并通过LVAI PDF Filler填写随附政府PDF表单。

skills.name: contract-intake
skills.description: Process a real estate contract and rider upload for a new transaction. Use when the user asks to "upload a contract", "new real estate transaction", "start a transaction", "review this contract", "process this contract and rider", "intake a new deal", "new closing", "new real estate deal", "I have a new contract", or uploads a real estate contract PDF/document and needs the transaction set up with dates calendared and rider preparation identified. Covers NJ and NY residential, condo, and co-op transactions for both buyer and seller representation.
skills.description_zh: 处理新房地产交易的合同与附加条款上传，设置交易、安排关键日期并识别待准备附件，覆盖新泽西和纽约住宅、公寓与合作产权买卖双方。

skills.name: date-calendaring
skills.description: Calendar all critical dates from a real estate transaction. Use when the user asks to "calendar the dates", "add dates to calendar", "schedule closing dates", "calendar this transaction", "add transaction dates", "calendar deadlines", "set up calendar reminders", "schedule real estate dates", or needs key transaction dates (deposit, inspections, mortgage commitment, closing) added to Google Calendar or Outlook. Automatically sets reminders and organizes events by transaction.
skills.description_zh: 将房地产交易的定金、检查、贷款承诺与交割等关键日期加入Google Calendar或Outlook，设置提醒并按交易组织事件。

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description: Conduct comprehensive deep legal research with extended analysis and full opinion text review. Use when the user asks for "deep research", "comprehensive research", "thorough analysis", "in-depth legal research", "exhaustive case law analysis", "deep dive into", or needs the most thorough possible legal research with full opinion text review and RAG-enhanced analysis on the Midpage or Descrybe connector, whichever the user has (both, when both are connected).
skills.description_zh: 通过已连接的Midpage或Descrybe进行深入法律研究，完整阅读判决文本并结合RAG扩展分析；两者都连接时同时使用。

skills.name: discovery
skills.description: Generate discovery documents including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission. Use when the user asks to "draft interrogatories", "create discovery requests", "write requests for production", "discovery questions", "draft RFPs", "create requests for admission", "generate discovery", "respond to interrogatories", or needs interrogatories, document requests, requests for admission or responses to them for divorce, custody, employment, personal injury, or other case types.
skills.description_zh: 为离婚、监护、劳动、人身伤害等案件起草证据发现文件，包括书面询问、文件提供要求、承认请求及答复。

skills.name: exhibit-binder
skills.description: Merge a set of exhibits (PDF, Word, images) into ONE court-ready PDF binder: caption cover page, Exhibit Index with page references, a tab page before every exhibit ("EXHIBIT A"), bookmarks, "Page X of Y" on every page and optional Bates numbers. Use when the user asks to "create an exhibit binder", "merge the exhibits", "combine these PDFs into one", "make one PDF of all the exhibits", "tab the exhibits", "exhibit list", "exhibit index", "Bates stamp the exhibits", "put the exhibits together for the motion", "appendix of exhibits", or has a folder of exhibit files that must go to the court or the other side as a single document. Works entirely on the user's computer — nothing is uploaded.
skills.description_zh: 在用户电脑将PDF、Word和图片证据合为法庭用PDF册，添加案名封面、带页码索引、每项证据分隔页、书签、总页码及可选Bates编号，原说明明确不上传材料。

skills.name: exhibits
skills.description: Attach the exhibits referenced in a certification, affirmation, affidavit or declaration: read the document, find every "attached hereto as Exhibit A is a true copy of …" reference, match each exhibit to the right file, check that the file is what the certification says it is, and produce the certification followed by tab pages and exhibits in ONE PDF (plus one PDF per exhibit and an exhibit list). Use when the user says "/exhibits", "attach the exhibits to my certification", "put the exhibits behind the certification", "tab and merge the exhibits referenced in the affidavit", "exhibits to the affirmation", "the exhibits have to match the certification", "add Exhibit A, B and C to the cert", or has a certification/affirmation and a folder of exhibit files that must go to the court together. Works entirely on the user's computer — nothing is uploaded. For a set of exhibits WITHOUT a certification (a motion appendix), use exhibit-binder.
skills.description_zh: 读取证明或宣誓文书中的证据附件引用，匹配文件并核查内容与陈述一致，生成文书加分隔页和附件的合并PDF、逐项PDF与清单；无证明文书的独立附件册使用exhibit-binder。

skills.name: hyperlinking
skills.description: Hyperlink all legal citations in a document (.docx) — case law to the opinion on Midpage (or on Descrybe when Midpage is not connected), statutes to Midpage's own law page for the section — or, without Midpage, to the section's page on law.onecle.com for that state or the U.S. Code — and federal rules to law.cornell.edu. Use when the user asks to "hyperlink citations", "add links to cases", "link case law", "hyperlink the brief", "hyperlink the memo", "add Midpage links", "add Descrybe links", "link citations", "hyperlink cases in my document", "link statutes", "hyperlink rules", or wants any legal document's citations turned into clickable hyperlinks. Also triggers when the user mentions "hyperlinking", "midpage links", "descrybe links", "onecle links", or wants citations in a brief or memorandum to be clickable. If the user has a .docx legal document and wants case names, statutes, or federal rules to link somewhere, use this skill. State court rules are intentionally not hyperlinked.
skills.description_zh: 为DOCX法律引文添加超链接，判例连接Midpage或Descrybe，法条连接Midpage或Onecle对应条文，联邦规则连接Cornell；原说明不为州法院规则加链接。

skills.name: legal-correction
skills.description: Auto-correct a legal document based on a Citation Verification Report, then re-verify the corrected document. Use when the user asks to "fix the citations", "correct the brief per the report", "apply the verification fixes", "fix the issues the verification report found", "narrow the holdings", "make the corrections from the report", or has just run /verify and wants the flagged citations actually fixed in the document. This is the natural follow-on to /verify — it reads the verification report's manifest, rewrites flagged passages of the brief to align with the verified case language, and runs a new verification check on the corrected document. Not for general editing requests.
skills.description_zh: 根据引文核验报告清单修改法律文书中被标记的段落，使主张匹配已核实判例措辞，再重新核验；用于核验后修正而非一般编辑。

skills.name: legal-research
skills.description: Conduct professional legal research with verified case law citations. Use when the user asks to "research a legal issue", "find case law", "search for precedents", "legal research on", "what does the law say about", "find cases supporting", "case law for", or needs authority on any legal question. Produces hyperlinked, Bluebook-formatted analysis backed by real case opinions via the Midpage or Descrybe connector — whichever the user has (both, when both are connected).
skills.description_zh: 通过Midpage或Descrybe实际判决开展法律问题、先例及支持判例研究，生成带超链接与Bluebook引文的分析；两者都连接时同时使用。

skills.name: legal-verification
skills.description: Verify legal citations, case claims, and document accuracy against real case law and produce a Citation Verification Report (a .docx that pairs each proposition in the brief with the verified language of the opinion). Use when the user asks to "verify citations", "check this brief", "verify case law", "are these citations real", "citation check", "verify legal claims", "check if this case exists", "verify holdings", "verification report", or needs to validate any legal document against actual court opinions — on the Midpage or Descrybe connector, whichever the user has (both, when both are connected). For a tabbed binder of the authorities with pull-quotes, use citation-binder instead.
skills.description_zh: 以Midpage或Descrybe实际判决核验法律引文、案件主张和文书准确性，生成逐项对照主张与判决语言的DOCX核验报告；带分隔页和摘引的判例册另用citation-binder。

skills.name: legal-writing
skills.description: Draft professional legal documents from uploaded research and materials. Use when the user asks to "draft a brief", "write a motion", "draft a memorandum", "write a legal document", "create a legal memo", "draft an opposition", "write legal arguments", "draft a complaint", "write a response", or needs any legal document drafted from provided materials. Produces Cardozo-standard legal prose with proper Bluebook citations.
skills.description_zh: 根据上传研究与材料起草书状、动议、备忘录、起诉状、反对意见及答复，按原说明采用Cardozo标准法律行文与Bluebook引文。

skills.name: license-status
skills.description: Show the user's own LVAI Pro / Legal Velocity license: who it is licensed to, license ID, seat, plan, expiry date, days left and status. Use when the user says "check my LVAI Pro license status", "check my license", "is my LVAI Pro license active", "when does my license expire", "LVAI Pro license status", "Legal Velocity license", "verify my license", "is my subscription active", "manage my LVAI Pro subscription", or asks anything about their own LVAI Pro license or renewal. This is a read-only check through the Legal Velocity connector; it needs no folder, no file and no admin tool.
skills.description_zh: 通过Legal Velocity连接器只读查看用户自身LVAI Pro许可，展示获许可人、许可ID、席位、计划、到期日、剩余天数和状态，无需文件夹、文件或管理员工具。

skills.name: pdf-form-filler
skills.description: Intelligent PDF form filling from source documents. Use when the user asks to "fill out a form", "complete a PDF", "fill in a case information statement", "fill CIS", "generate a CIS", "fill court form", "auto-fill PDF", "populate a form from documents", "fill out paperwork", "complete court paperwork", "generate form from tax returns", "fill financial statement", or needs any PDF form automatically populated from uploaded source documents such as tax returns, paystubs, W-2s, 1099s, divorce filings, bank statements, or financial records. Handles both fillable PDF forms and non-fillable static PDF forms. Preserves exact original document formatting and layout.
skills.description_zh: 从税表、工资单、W-2、1099、离婚材料、银行流水等来源自动填充PDF表单，支持可填写与静态表单，并保留原格式和布局。

skills.name: rider-generator
skills.description: Generate a real estate contract rider for buyer or seller representation. Use when the user asks to "prepare a rider", "draft a rider", "create a rider", "buyer's rider", "seller's rider", "generate rider", "contract rider for", "condo rider", "co-op rider", "residential rider", or needs a rider document prepared for a NJ or NY real estate transaction. Supports residential, condo, and co-op property types with state-specific provisions for both buyer and seller sides.
skills.description_zh: 为新泽西或纽约房地产买方或卖方起草合同附加条款，支持住宅、公寓和合作产权及各州特定条文。

skills.name: title-review
skills.description: Review a title binder or title commitment — requirements, exceptions, chain of title, graded RED / YELLOW / GREEN — in a Title Review Report, and (seller side) generate the closing documents from it once the missing details are collected. Use when the user asks to "review title", "title binder review", "review title commitment", "analyze title search", "title report review", "check title", "title examination", "title issues", "create closing docs from title", "closing from title binder", or uploads a title binder, title commitment, or title search report and needs it reviewed. Covers NJ and NY transactions.
skills.description_zh: 审查新泽西或纽约产权册、产权保险承诺与查询报告中的要求、例外及产权链，以红黄绿评级生成报告；卖方补齐信息后可据此生成交割文件。

headings: What this plugin runs, sends and fetches

name: lvai pro
summary_zh: 主要用于法律与公共事务，可查找“法规检索与合规研究”相关技能或服务。具体操作范围见包内说明。
description: The complete Legal Velocity AI platform for Claude. Legal research, citation verification, Citation Binders and legal writing on the Midpage or Descrybe connector — whichever the firm has (both are cross-checked when both are connected); NJ and NY real estate transaction management (contracts, riders, closing documents, title review, date calendaring); intelligent PDF form filling. Skill content is delivered by the Legal Velocity connector under the firm's license.
requirements: 提及命令行工具或本地运行环境（根据说明文字识别，具体步骤见原文）
evidence_note: 基于包内静态说明；未安装、未运行，作者宣称的效果未验收。
classification_basis: 说明与技能匹配，支持多用途标签
